The lowest common ancestor of these interactions is the polycyclic compound, suggesting a shared functional or structural role in the pathway. The relationship between Debrisoquin and Slc6a2 is thus mediated through Cyp2d6 and Protriptyline, highlighting a complex network of molecular interactions.
